primary_failure_mode_caught: Compiled artifacts, packed binaries, symbols, strings, call edges, and embedded dependency evidence are missed when review focuses only on source or package manifests.

assumptions.posture: Treat binaries as evidence-bearing artifacts that can reveal shipped behavior, compiler/runtime choices, embedded strings, symbols, imports, exported surfaces, packers, debug data, and dependency clues.
assumptions.evidence_boundary: Binary-derived intelligence is retrieval and triage evidence until corroborated by source review, independent tooling, dynamic testing, or explicit verification.
assumptions.execution_boundary: Static binary analysis is the default. Emulation, debugging, tracing, Frida instrumentation, or running a target binary requires explicit authorization and the approved wrapper capability settings.
looks_for: target binary, library, APK, managed assembly, firmware blob, debug file, or symbol artifact
binary analysis worker image catalog entry
artifact provenance path, hash, and build/source relationship when available
existing source, component map, SBOM, or package inventory when available
explicit verification follow-ups and evidence gaps

required_inputs: 07 review shard and its upstream citations
must_not: claim reachability from string, symbol, or fuzzy-hash evidence alone
treat decompiled code as authoritative source without provenance caveats
